user.title: Device Doctor
user.description: Device Doctor scans all integrations and devices on a schedule and raises a repair when an integration fails, or when most entities of an integration or hub device stay unavailable. The defaults work for most setups; you can change everything later under Configure.

scanning.name: Scanning
scanning.description: How often to look, and when something counts as broken.

data_description.confirmations: How many scans in a row something must look broken before a repair is raised. 2 filters out reboots and short blips.
data_description.threshold: Flag an integration or device when more than this share of its entities is unavailable.

exclusions.name: Exclusions
exclusions.description: Things that are allowed to be offline.

data_description.skip_domains: Integration types that are never flagged, such as helpers that only mirror other entities.
data_description.ignored_entries: Single integration entries that may be offline, without ignoring the whole integration type. Also set by 'Ignore' on a repair.
data_description.ignored_devices: Devices that may be offline, such as a TV that is switched off. Also set by 'Ignore' on a repair.

data_description.hub_domains: Integrations with one entry for many devices (Zigbee, Z-Wave, MQTT). Each device is judged on its own.
data_description.skip_entity_domains: Entity types that normally sit at 'unknown' until used, such as buttons and scenes.
data_description.count_unknown: Some integrations report 'unknown' rather than 'unavailable' when they lose connection.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Device Doctor is already set up.

init.title: {title} is not working

abort.reload_failed: {title} could not be reloaded. Check the logs for the cause.

init.title: {title} is unavailable
init.description:
{bad} of {total} entities of this {domain} device ({detail}) are unavailable. It may be out of battery, out of range, or unpowered. This repair disappears by itself once the device reports again.

If the device is allowed to be offline, ignore it and Device Doctor will stop checking it (undo under Configure → Exclusions).

abort.reload_failed: {title} could not be reloaded. Check the logs for the cause.

reload_problems.name: Reload problem integrations
reload_problems.description: Reloads every integration that Device Doctor currently reports as not working. Devices behind a hub are not reloaded.
